title: Launch Checklist & Reading Results
objectives: Run through the pre-flight checklist before hitting the Publish button
Know what metrics to check on Day 1, Day 3, and Day 7
Master the golden rule of what NOT to touch during learning

blocks.text: Congratulations on reaching Lesson 10! You are ready to launch your first live campaign.

blocks.title: The 5-Point Pre-Flight Launch Checklist
items: 1. Objective Matches Goal (Leads for forms/WhatsApp, Sales for e-commerce)
2. Destination URL & Tracking tested (Lead form opens, Pixel fires)
3. Budget set appropriately (3x-5x target CPL daily)
4. Spelling, pricing, and phone numbers verified in ad text
5. Correct payment method & GST details active

rows: Confirm budget is spending; DO NOT judge results yet!
If CTR > 1.2%, creative is working. Check if first leads arrived.
Calculate actual ROI. Decide whether to scale or refresh creative.

blocks.text: Check Breakdown Reporting by Placement (Reels vs Feed) and Age to see where your cheapest results originate.
Do NOT turn off an ad after 3 hours because it hasn't generated a sale. Meta needs 24-48 hours to balance delivery!

quiz.q: What should you check on Day 1 after hitting Publish on your new campaign?
options: Calculate annual revenue and quit your job
Verify that impressions are delivering and spend is pacing properly without making any edits
Delete the ad if zero leads arrived in the first 2 hours
quiz.hint: Day 1 is only for verifying technical health and delivery.
quiz.explain: On Day 1, simply ensure the ad is active and spending smoothly. Give the algorithm time to find prospects.

quiz.q: On Day 3, your CTR is healthy at 2.1%, but you have received zero leads. Where is the most likely problem?
options: The creative hook failed to get attention
The landing page or lead form: it might be broken, too slow, or asking for too much info
quiz.hint: High CTR means people are clicking eagerly, but dropping off after arriving.
quiz.explain: A high CTR with zero conversions indicates people like the ad, but the landing page or form fails to convert them.

quiz.q: True or False: Checking your campaign breakdown reports by age and placement helps you identify your most profitable customer segments.
quiz.hint: Can you see results separated by Feed vs Stories, or age brackets?
quiz.explain: True! Breakdowns reveal exactly which placements and demographics generate the cheapest results.

quiz.q: Order the stages of reviewing a newly launched campaign from earliest to latest.
quiz.explain: You check pre-flight items, confirm delivery on Day 1, analyze engagement on Day 3, and evaluate ROI on Day 7.

recap: Run the 5-point pre-flight checklist before launching.
Be patient: judge delivery on Day 1, CTR on Day 3, and CPL/ROAS on Day 7.
